# Shiva Swaroop N K

> Personal site and portfolio of Shiva Swaroop N K (Shiva Swaroop Nittoor
> Krishnamurthy), cloud infrastructure engineer in Stockholm. Kubernetes,
> GitOps, software supply-chain security; Carnatic music and travel otherwise.
> DevOps Engineer at Youmoni; MSc at KTH; co-organizer of Cloud Native
> Stockholm (CNCF).

This site serves agents natively: page requests with an agent User-Agent, an
`Accept: text/markdown` preference, or `?format=md` receive markdown instead
of HTML.

## Content

- [Full profile (markdown)](https://shivu.io/agent.md): everything on the site (work, projects, talks, contact)
- [CV as JSON Resume](https://shivu.io/resume.json): machine-readable career data
- [Blog](https://shivu.io/blog): "Shiv Writes About Stuff", hosted on Notion

## Elsewhere
